newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends stronger on bullish interest.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends stronger on bullish interest.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed more than half a Canadian cent stronger on Monday at C$1.3641 (US$0.7329) from Friday's close at C$1.3698 (US$0.7301) in moderate volumes, traders said.
* The currency started the day weak on selling out of Chicago, but a steady interest to buy pushed the currency back past a key technical point, encouraging more buying.
With the holiday season over, market players enjoyed full liquidity for the first time in about two weeks, helping to bolster the market, traders said.
Investors viewed the currency as undervalued in a time when Canadian economic fundamentals were strong, they said.
The market anxiously awaited unemployment numbers from Canada and the United States expected this Friday, traders said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1446 marks from Friday's close of 1.1432 marks but slipped to 84.70 yen from 84.91 yen.
